description: Use only after the user agrees to a change that price_change priced ("yes, add the SMS reminders"). Changes data; needs sign-in. Pass exactly accept_with.arguments from price_change: id, proposal_id, base_version and change. The plan is updated in one step and the project gets a new context_version; calling it again with the same proposal changes nothing and returns the same result (safe to retry). It is refused when the project changed after base_version (another accepted change, new users or answers): the answer says what changed, and you re-price with price_change. A change that breaks a must-have is refused. decision "reject" records that the user turned it down, without changing the plan. Never accept on the user's behalf without asking; this never changes anything outside Kong Reviews.

base_version.description: The context_version the change was priced on (price_change's accept_with).

change.description: The same change object that was priced.

name: accept_change

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

completeness.description: On plan and project results: complete, complete_with_assumptions, incomplete or needs_clarification, with the reasons. Say plainly when it is not complete.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

project.description: On results about a saved project: its id and the context version the answer was computed on. Pass both back in follow-up calls.

title: Accept (or reject) a priced change into the project
